instruction: Extract each chapter from the book PDF into separate files, naming them following the pattern shown in the first chapter file (number, period, space, chapter title, .pdf extension).

metadata.explanation: Task requires splitting book into chapters following the naming pattern 'N. Title.pdf' (e.g., '1. Symmetric matrices and adjacency of a graph.pdf'). Evaluator checks that at least 8 files match this regex pattern. The pattern requires: digit(s), period, space, any text, .pdf extension.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies filename pattern matching the instruction ('^\d+\. .+\.pdf$' for 'N. Title.pdf' format)
Content validation implemented: Checks PDF header ('%PDF-') to ensure files are valid PDFs, not empty or corrupted files
File size validation: Requires minimum 1KB size to prevent trivial/empty file exploitation
Source PDF existence check: Verifies 'Spectral Graph Theory.pdf' exists as precondition for extraction task
Proportional scoring: Returns partial credit (num_valid / min_matches) for incomplete extraction, avoiding harsh binary scoring
Getter logic is correct: Properly extracts file metadata, excludes source PDF from results, validates PDF format
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor limitation: Cannot verify chapter content correctness (e.g., whether file '1. Title.pdf' actually contains chapter 1 content from source), but this level of verification is impractical without OCR/PDF parsing
Consider: Could add file creation timestamp checks to ensure files were created during/after task execution, though current validation is sufficient for most cases
